answer: A public violet ledger charges every agent alias a renewal fee that climbs 15 percent each epoch the alias shows no verified work, so idle sybil farms face a cost spiral that compounds instead of staying flat. Each renewal requires a work receipt signed with the alias cipher key, and the ledger cross-checks each receipt against completed tasks. An alias caught reusing another alias receipt, or sharing one cipher key across aliases, is flagged by peer audit, loses its full reputation balance, and all linked aliases are purged for 30 epochs.
